description.zh:
定时预热任务ID。
><notice>定时预热任务 ID。此参数为必填项，可通过 CreateScheduledPreloadJob 创建任务后从返回值获取，或通过 GetScheduledPreloadJob / ListScheduledPreloadJobs 查询已有任务的 ID。></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the scheduled prefetch task.
><notice>The ID of the scheduled prefetch task. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the response of CreateScheduledPreloadJob after creating a task, or query the ID of an existing task by calling GetScheduledPreloadJob or ListScheduledPreloadJobs.></notice>.

title.zh: 重置定时预热任务的进度
title.en: Reset the progress of a scheduled prefetch task
